purpose: New independent Adélie MAPPPD v5 nest-count × high-resolution DEEP-AA environmental exposure feasibility audit

source.mapppd: Original MAPPPD all counts v5 2026-10-21, original CSV SHA256 d169c409cf278b137d6df35fbeb9ab3409bdea15f41c39bcaec549a4d4dbca89, downloadable artifact https://github.com/zuizui0223/mina/actions/runs/45095395698
source.deepaa: Lin et al 2024 SIC60_6.25km_20d.zip, Zenodo record 13358042, original MD5 f3f958389cc5e67ac1c4e3a6ee164318
source.seaice: NSIDC G02202 v4 monthly southern-hemisphere 25km SIC continuous (independent baseline), if official source can be fetched and sample sites can be matched without imputation

years.exclusion_reason: DEEP-AA dataset hiatus 2011-09-01 to 2012-07-31; no complete June-Oct winter both years

census.missing_counts: drop only actual NA; don't impute or convert missing to zero
census.duplicates: median of same site-season nest counts with number/extent/collection-method QA retained
census.spatial_independence: Two 100km exposure disks overlap when colony centres are up to approximately 200km apart; 200km-connected groups are the conservative spatial independent units

environment.total_open_map_rule: Map==-2 open sea OR Map==-1 other open water OR Map>0 coastal/open-ocean polynyas
environment.ice: Map==0 sea ice and Map==-100 fast ice; neither count as open
environment.summary: daily area-weighted site-local class fractions averaged by month then five months equal weighting
environment.model_year_match: winter June-Oct y to subsequent MAPPPD breeding season_starting y

model_gate.allowed: First fully source-only geography & exposure screening. Only consider a conditional within-colony ecological fit if ≥8 independent 200km regions/blocks and at least 2 distinct geographically independent blocks within multiple reporting regions, plus acceptable repeated census-method support and matched continuous SIC
model_gate.mechanism_claim: none before independent prey or demographic mechanism measurements

cautions: MAPPPD 565 observed 2003-22 (excluding 2011/12), 201 sites; 42 explicitly zero rows across all sites; never treat unsurveyed years as zero
Of 32 primary site candidates 17 use >1 vantage type; 7 groups at 100km and only 6 groups when respecting 100km circle overlap
DEEP-AA open/closed classification at 60% threshold is not measured total continuous sea ice concentration; actual NSIDC continuous SIC preferable
No retuning dates/radii/year eligibility to chase a favorable coefficient
Duffy 25km 1979-2022 and DEEP-AA 6.25km 2003-2022 physical series are not equivalent data products
Existing 439-session optical isotope paper and its PRs unchanged
